front: Stride, and try to move through an enemy's space with an Acrobatics check vs. its Reflex DC.
back:
Stride up to your Speed, trying to enter one enemy's space. Acrobatics vs. its Reflex DC. May use Climb, Fly, Swim, etc. instead of Stride.
Success: you move through its space; its squares are difficult terrain (5 ft costs 10 ft). If you lack the Speed to get through, treat as failure.
Failure: movement ends and you trigger reactions as if you left your starting square.
